name: Finding Angles in Englewood 2026
information:
Welcome to the first ever competition in Englewood!

All competitors must read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FindingAnglesinEnglewood2026#83044-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab before registering.
 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png)

**On-the-spot registration is NOT enabled** for this competition! If you would like to compete, please register before November 29th, and before our registration cap has been filled to insure your spot.

Live results, group assignments, and a more in-depth schedule can be found on the [Important Day-of Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FindingAnglesinEnglewood2026#83047-important-day-of-information) tab.
